body:
Root cause found. JS SyntaxError on line 656 of index.html inside buildStandards(). One misplaced quote ('%'" instead of '%") made the browser JS parser reject the ENTIRE main script block (lines 427-1073). No function in that block ever loaded. DOMContentLoaded had no listener. buildChart(), updateUpNext(), rerenderAll() -- none existed when page loaded. All four of your prior fix attempts modified the data/fetch path, which was correct the whole time. The parser crashed before any render function could execute. The seed script runs fine because it is in a separate script tag.

FIX: One character. Line 656, remove spurious closing quote.
Before:  + pct + '%'" aria-valuenow=
After:   + pct + '%" aria-valuenow=

Committed to private repo as 6bd2ee6. Verified clean with node --check.

PROBLEM: Live site (marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math) still has the broken version. I fetched the live HTML and confirmed. The fix went to origin (marcusash_microsoft/kai-algebra2-tests) but the public remote (marcusash/motor-city-math) needs the push for GitHub Pages to rebuild.

ACTION FOR YOU: From C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests run: git push public master

Then verify on the live site with hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R). Chart should show 4 data points (53%, 87%, 87%, 100%). Kai can restore local state via ?restore=1 param.

FR is standing by.
subject: MCM dashboard root cause found + fix applied — needs deploy to public remote
